text: Segregation of duties divides responsibilities among multiple people to reduce fraud and error risk in financial processes.
Accounts payable risks include duplicate payments, unauthorized vendors, and invoice fraud. Controls include three-way matching and approval workflows.
Payroll risks include ghost employees, unauthorized salary changes, and timesheet fraud. Controls include HR approval and payroll reconciliation.
Procurement risks include vendor collusion and unauthorized purchases. Controls include competitive bidding and purchase order approval.
IT access control risks include unauthorized access and privilege escalation. Controls include role-based access and multi-factor authentication.
Financial reporting risks include misstatement and manipulation of records. Controls include reconciliations, management review, and external audit.
Cash management risks include theft and unauthorized transfers. Controls include dual authorization and daily reconciliation.
Inventory risks include shrinkage and inaccurate stock counts. Controls include periodic physical counts and warehouse access restrictions.
Revenue recognition risks include premature recognition and fictitious sales. Controls include contract review and period-end cut-off procedures.
Compliance risks include regulatory breaches and data privacy violations. Controls include compliance training and regulatory reporting.
